title: Japan 10-year Inflation-Indexed JGB auction — the quarterly print that prices Japan's own breakeven, four days before the 1-5y liquidity-enhancement menu next rolls
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes) — its table row reads 'Nov. 16, 2026 | 10-year Inflation-Indexed Bonds', with both the announcement and result cells still unlinked, so nothing has been published for it yet. Quarterly Feb/May/Aug/Nov cadence reproduced independently from MOF's own Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls workbook (past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13), whose 10年物価連動 sheet prints 2025-02-12, 2025-05-22, 2025-08-15, 2025-11-17, 2026-02-10 and 2026-05-01 without a gap; the 2026-08-12 edition is missing from the workbook but confirmed on MOF's own August calendar 2608e.htm (HTTP 200, 29,133 bytes), whose row carries a live announcement link (calendar/announcement/auct20260805e.htm) and a live result link (calendar/eresul/eresul20260812.htm). Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office; the date is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Discovered 2026-09-15 during the event-passed-unscored close-out of jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-09-10
notes: PROPOSED because it measures the one variable the proposer's own close-out could not separate, not because it completes a calendar. That ledger's leg 3 claims the 1-5y liquidity-enhancement menu's '≥1% coupon' bucket is contaminated by rising Japanese coupons rather than reporting a live preference, and its 2026-09-10 close-out confirmed that in the sharpest possible form: the ≥1% side of the auction took 64.9% of accepted, 43.0pp of it 2-Year and only 21.9pp 20-Year, with the single largest line being 2-Year No.488 — coupon 1.7%, first issued 2026-09-01, NINE DAYS OLD — at ¥273.7bn, 39.22% of the whole ¥697.9bn auction. The coupon path is the driver, and this instrument prices it directly: the linker's own coupon jumped from 0.005% (No.30, unchanged across five auctions from 2025-02 to 2026-02) to 0.6% (No.31, 2026-05-01), a 119bp step that is the same re-rise moving 2-Year and 5-Year paper across the ≥1% threshold in the liquidity-enhancement menu. A breakeven print four days before jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-11-20 is the closest thing this family has to a leading read on its own denominator drift. A SECOND, SMALLER REASON, and it is a repeat offence: the 2026-08-12 linker auction ran with a published MOF result page and is ABSENT from the Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls workbook (saved 2026-08-13), exactly as 2-Year No.488 was — the staleness that made the family's shared ¥321.15tn eligible-stock basis omit a bond and overstate the 2-Year share by ~7% relative. A tracked linker auction is a second place where that save-date lag becomes visible on schedule instead of by accident. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and a quarterly sovereign linker is among the least market-moving instruments this calendar tracks. It sits two days before jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18 and four before jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-11-20. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
